en.text: The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. is no one who does good.

zhSimplified.text: 愚顽人心里说：没有 神。

zhTraditional.text: 愚頑人心裏說：沒有上帝。

en.text: The LORD looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华从天上垂看世人，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華從天上垂看世人，

en.text: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on the LORD?

zhSimplified.text: 作孽的都没有知识吗？ 吃饭一样，

zhTraditional.text: 作孽的都沒有知識嗎？ 吃飯一樣，

en.text: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.

zhSimplified.text: 他们在那里大大地害怕，

zhTraditional.text: 他們在那裏大大地害怕，

en.text: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.

zhSimplified.text: 你们叫困苦人的谋算变为羞辱；

zhTraditional.text: 你們叫困苦人的謀算變為羞辱；

en.text: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When the LORD restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

zhSimplified.text: 但愿的救恩从而出。 要快乐，要欢喜。

zhTraditional.text: 但願的救恩從而出。 要快樂，要歡喜。
